control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console HD-2: one host with tabs Ringkasan, Jadwal, Kehadiran (edit clock in, tier, weekly), Report, Payroll and Data pribadi (masked, reveal is logged by canvas).

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: scoreInitial, scoreMin, scoreMax, piiRevealSeconds (30), payrollLabelOffset (-1).

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON of ONE [Host - PBS Hub] row with masking hints KtpLast4, NorekLast4, PhoneLast4, HasRekening, HasAlamat, HasNamaRekening, HasPersonalEmail, Bank. Never send the raw KTP, NoRekening, Alamat, PhoneNumber or PersonalEmail.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for this host (recent and upcoming).

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] for this host: Title, LiveDate, BrandID, Platform, Penjualan, ApprovalStatus, ApprovalComment, Modified.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for this host, current and previous month: ClockInDate, CheckInTime, CheckOutTime, HKTugas, Insentif, Streak. No GPS or selfie columns.

property.name: PayrollDataJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Payroll Data] for this host: payroll_id, Periode, JumlahHari, TotalGaji, PPh21, NetTHP, Bank, NorekLast4. Never send Employee_ID or the full Norek.

property.name: PayrollJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Payroll - PBS Hub] the lines refer to (Title, Periode, Status, gate columns, Created).

property.name: ScoreTxJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreTransactions for this host: TransactionID, RuleID, TransactionType, Point, ScoreBefore, ScoreAfter, Reason, Notes, Status, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.

property.name: ThresholdsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreThreshold: ThresholdID, Label, Description, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, Tone, Active, SortOrder.

property.name: BrandsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Brand - PBS Hub] (Title, NamaBrand) for names in Jadwal and Report.

property.name: StudiosJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Studio - PBS Hub] (Title, NamaStudio) for names in Jadwal.

property.name: RevealedJson
property.description-key: JSON {hostId,field,value} set by canvas only after it logged a REVEAL_PII request. Clear it on HIDE_PII and on screen exit.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeletons.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message} to REVEAL_PII, SET_HOST_STATUS, ADD_CLOCK_IN and ADJUST_CLOCK_IN.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: BACK, RELOAD, NAV, OPEN_SCHEDULE, OPEN_REPORT, OPEN_RUN, REVEAL_PII, HIDE_PII, SET_HOST_STATUS, ADD_CLOCK_IN, ADJUST_CLOCK_IN.
